name: erpnext-operations
description: Safely operate ERPNext across business and administrative roles through its authenticated REST API.

interface.longDescription: Onboard and operate an authorized ERPNext API user across organization administration, accounting, sales, buying, stock, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, HR, projects, support, website, marketing, knowledge, analytics, and system management. Credentials are copied from a user-selected key file into a persistent owner-read-only local file.
defaultPrompt: Onboard my ERPNext API user from a key file.
Inspect my ERPNext organization without changes.
Plan an ERPNext operation and show the impact first.
